headline: Matt #2 and Tecnod8.AI leap into the top 100

sections.text: Matt #2 gained 6.61 to reach 34.44, moving from 1,084th to 48th. Tecnod8.AI gained 5.16 to reach 34.12, moving from 828th to 54th.
The simultaneous climbs put both teams among the upper tier of the ARC-AGI-3 public standings.
